description: CORS check for a public HTTPS endpoint: three GET requests with a made-up origin, the null origin and no origin, reporting whether the server echoes the origin, allows null, returns a wildcard, and allows credentials. Only reads response headers of GET requests; it does not test preflight, methods or authentication.
